text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Sei-chan. There's no way you'll 
be able to guess what your birthday 
present is this year!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Spe-chan! Even though you guess your 
present every single year! This year, 
it'll absolutely, definitely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... back then... yeah. 
Fish-shaped cookies, an extra-large carrot 
cake... those were pretty easy to tell by 
the smell.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, food was the theme before... Maybe a 
physical gift this year? Hmm, hehe. 
Something related to Sei-chan, but 
unexpected... Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Huhhh? This is so hard to guess! What 
could it beee? Hmmmm!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight!! Listen to this and be amazed! 
Get this! A pillow made for your desk—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...and on top of that, a pillow mist! 
How's that?! A two-pronged approach! Bet 
you didn't see that coming!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaaat!? Whoa, I didn't see this 
coming at all! It's way too stylish, I'm 
blown away!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(Both of them have been smelling really 
nice with a new scent every day lately... 
I guess they've been testing a bunch of 
different ones, but still...)

text_block_list.name: Spe & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Tsuru-chan! We sure did, 
Spe-chan!
